literal: Without moving away, without approaching, fire those-who-warm-themselves let-them-be-like, conflict kings having-joined those-who-conduct-themselves.
translation: Those who associate with powerful kings should act like people warming themselves at a fire, neither moving too far away nor approaching too closely.
modern: வலிமைமிக்க அரசர்களைச் சார்ந்து வாழ்பவர்கள், குளிருக்காகத் தீக்காய்வாரைப் போல அரசரை விட்டு மிகவும் விலகாமலும், மிகவும் நெருங்காமலும் அளவோடு பழக வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet advises those who serve or associate with kings on the proper distance to maintain. It uses the simile of warming oneself at a fire. If one gets too close to the fire, it burns; if one moves too far away, it does not provide warmth. Similarly, being too intimate with powerful rulers can be dangerous, while being too distant means losing their favor and protection.
